description: This PHP source file contains functions related to ad delivery limitations, including checks for ad and zone capping, blocking rules, and cookie-based user tracking within the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: MAX_limitationsCheckAcl
methods.description: Checks if an ad's compiled limitation allows it to be shown based on included plugins and evaluation of limitation code.

methods.name: MAX_limitationsIsAdForbidden
methods.description: Determines if an ad is blocked or capped based on ad and campaign rules.

methods.name: MAX_limitationsIsZoneForbidden
methods.description: Checks if a zone is blocked or capped based on zone rules.

methods.name: _limitationsIsAdCapped
methods.description: Private function to check if an ad is capped based on ad capping rules.

methods.name: _limitationsIsCampaignCapped
methods.description: Private function to check if a campaign is capped.

methods.name: _limitationsIsZoneCapped
methods.description: Private function to check if a zone is capped.

methods.name: _limitationsIsCapped
methods.description: Core private function to determine if an item (ad, campaign, zone) is capped based on cookies and limits.

methods.name: _areCookiesDisabled
methods.description: Checks if cookies are disabled or if the user has cookies enabled based on tracking.
